subtitle.en: Equations that relate a function to its own rate of change — separable and linear first-order equations, second-order equations whose solutions oscillate, grow, or decay, driven equations solved by undetermined coefficients, variation of parameters, or the Laplace transform, systems of linear ODEs, power series solutions, and the numerical methods used when no closed form exists at all.
